fields.label: Delivery Capacity
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — solo, small team, agency, or platform/software; what can realistically be built and fulfilled

fields.label: Target Service / Offer
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — the specific service or product this lead magnet must feed into

fields.label: Funnel Entry Point (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — where traffic will find this lead magnet: pillar page, ad, organic search, referral, etc.

fields.label: ICP Document
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — paste, attach, or say "use the ICP established earlier in this conversation." Should cover avatar, pains, goals, decision criteria, awareness level, research behaviour, objections, and language

fields.label: CRO / Messaging Framework
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — paste, attach, or reference the CRO audit / pillar page copy already established, so tone and locked terminology carry through

fields.label: Pillar Page
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — paste, attach, or reference the pillar page already established. Provides locked service names and existing CTA labels this lead magnet must not contradict

fields.label: Funnel Document
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — paste, attach, or reference the funnel already established. Identifies any lead magnet(s) already live, so this exercise adds to the ladder rather than duplicating it

fields.label: Offers / Value Ladder Document
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — paste, attach, or reference the value ladder already established. Identifies what Rung 0/1 already exists and what this lead magnet should ascend into

fields.label: Competitor Lead Magnet List
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — attach or reference a file/spreadsheet listing competitors in this industry and their best-known lead magnet: domain, name, format, mechanic, gated or ungated, and any notes on positioning or perceived value. Now sourced from the paired Competitor Analysis — Lead Magnet stage (03_Lead_Magnet.md); falls back to asking the user for a manual attachment if that stage hasn't been run.

fields.label: Brand Design Reference
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — the live website URL to extract colours/fonts/buttons from (if different from Client Website URL above), OR a design-system reference doc already established in this conversation, OR paste explicit brand values: primary colour hex, secondary colour hex, font family, button style, logo file

fields.label: Regulated Field Flag
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — Yes/No. If yes, name the regulation so compliance language is applied correctly

fields.label: Regulation Name
fields.raw_explanation: Name the regulation (medical, legal, financial, insurance, immigration, childcare, real estate, etc.) so compliance language is applied correctly.
